text: At dusk Crane addressed the council on the quay, with documents, stamps and a very good pen.
Salvage rights, he said. A small fee. And the keeper should rest, after such a hard month.
All in favour. Thank you. Keeper, the council thanks you for your service.
Gus walked home without a word. He set down two bowls by the door, as he had every night for eleven years.
Only one was eaten. Mabel had not come home.
